description: This file implements functions for converting between UTF-8 and UTF-16 encodings, adjusting string offsets, and merging adjustments, as part of the Chromium project.

classes.name: OffsetAdjuster::Adjustment
classes.description: Represents an adjustment to string offsets, including original offset, length, and output length.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffsets
methods.description: Adjusts a list of offsets based on a set of string adjustments up to a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::AdjustOffset
methods.description: Adjusts a single offset based on string adjustments and a limit.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::UnadjustOffsets
methods.description: Reverts offset adjustments for a list of offsets.

methods.name: OffsetAdjuster::MergeSequentialAdjustments
methods.description: Merges two sets of string adjustments into a single set, maintaining correct offsets.

methods.name: ConvertUnicode
methods.description: Template function converting Unicode characters from source to destination string type, recording adjustments if needed.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16WithAdjustments
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 with offset adjustments.

methods.name: UTF8ToUTF16AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and adjusts offsets accordingly.

methods.name: UTF16ToUTF8AndAdjustOffsets
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 to UTF-8 and adjusts offsets accordingly.
